reason: Ten stores minimum at PHP 8,000 each is PHP 80,000 a month, almost a million pesos locked in for a year, right after a slow quarter when I'm being told to cut. That money hires several more store staff, and I can see what staff do for me.
objection: They have no customer results, so I'd be paying a year upfront to be their test case with no proof that moving a shelf on a simulation actually adds sales in my stores.
would_change_my_mind: A free or paid-by-results pilot in two or three of my stores against control stores that shows a sales lift covering the fee, with no 12-month lock-in.
